It is intended to let application developers write once, run anywhere (WORA), meaning that code that runs on one platform does not need to be recompiled to run on another. Java applications are typically compiled to bytecode (class file) that can run on any Java virtual machine (JVM) regardless of computer architecture. Java is standardized by the Java Community Process. The language derives much of its syntax from C and C++, but it has fewer low-level facilities than either of them.

The flamingo's coloration is pink or reddish-pink, due to the presence of carotenoids in their diet. The flamingo's feathers are white, but the younger flamingos are more of a pale grey color. PREFACE.

I have been asked to write a Preface to this little book, and I have no hesitation in doing so, because I have been asked by the author himself.

I have known Mr. Ruskin for many years, and I have always found him a most earnest and sincere student of Art. He has a great love for the beautiful, and a great desire to make others love it too.

I have no doubt that this little book will be read with interest by all who take an interest in Art, and I hope that it will be found to contain much valuable information.

EDWIN LANDSEER.
